title: Sticky
description: made too much sticks? don't worry this mod fixes that by adding a crafting recipe turn sticks into wood planks.
body:
this mod requires [FabricLoader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/) 0.17.2 and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api). (works with [quilt](https://quiltmc.org/en/install/))

simply a mod that adds a new crafting recipe to reCraft oak planks from sticks.
here are scenarios that you can use this mod on:
- your stuck in desert or savanna;
- superflat world;
- one block world.
- stuck in a cave...?
